_meta.title: RULE-ENTITY-### registry
_meta.note: Structured form of the prose registry. Read the prose document for full 'why' explanations; this file is for programmatic reference (e.g. a future checklist tool or PR-review aid).

rules.statement: Name similarity alone is never sufficient for a canonical merge, at any tier of fuzziness, for any entity type.
rules.evidence: isPureEncodingVariant never authorizes SAFE_TO_CANONICALIZE alone in lib/acquisition/duplicates.ts

rules.statement: Country agreement is a hard gate before any name-based match is accepted; no country evidence on either side is a refusal, not a low-confidence accept.
A shared parent/system does not make two entities the same entity; a campus or school-group member must remain its own row, related, never merged into its parent.
A translation alias is only correct when official evidence supports equivalence; alias_type and language_code are independent axes.
rules.evidence: Koç School: official + tr simultaneously, not translation

rules.statement: A renamed institution needs either a legacy alias (same row) or explicit successor_of/predecessor_of evidence (two rows) -- never neither, never both for the same event.
rules.evidence: Constructor University has full external-id coverage but zero alias rows for its former names

rules.statement: An abbreviation match is never sufficient alone; well-known-feeling abbreviations collide across countries in the registry today.
rules.evidence: UM (Uruguay/Malaysia), UP (Argentina/Mexico), UPM (Spain/Malaysia) -- live coexisting alias collisions

rules.statement: A disagreeing external id in a shared id_system is decisive against a match, overriding even an identical name.
rules.evidence: classifyDuplicateCandidate()'s conflicting branch, checked before any name evidence

rules.statement: An agreeing external id in a shared id_system is the only path to the auto-safe tier -- nothing else reaches it, not an exact name, not a compatible city, not both together.
rules.evidence: all 41 live 'Boston/Boston, MA'-shaped pairs have exact name + compatible city and none reach SAFE_TO_CANONICALIZE

rules.statement: Do not create a second row solely to hang a relationship off it -- a pure rename is a one-row edit (add a legacy alias), never a phantom second row.
rules.evidence: derived from testing RULE-ENTITY-005 against Constructor University

rules.statement: Missing external-id coverage on one side of an otherwise-exact match is an enrichment gap, not evidence against a match. Complete enrichment; don't guess and don't leave it as unexplained AMBIGUOUS forever.
rules.evidence: all 41 queued Phase-6 duplicate candidates fit this exact shape, precisely dated to two 2026-08-16 bulk-import batches

rules.statement: Cross-entity-type merges are always refused, even when a real institution operates as both kinds. That relationship is school_of, never shared identity.
rules.evidence: merge_canonical_entities() raises on v_source_type <> v_target_type, a DB-level hard refusal

rules.statement: A relationship row's direction (subject vs object) encodes meaning; reversing it changes the claim even though the row still validates.
rules.evidence: school_of rows consistently put the school as subject, the university as object

rules.statement: Do not create a system/parent/organization entity until at least two children justify it.
rules.evidence: every populated organization-type school-system entity already has multiple linked schools

rules.statement: verification_state='user_submitted' is not low-quality evidence of falsehood. It is an unresolved claim -- queue and check it, never silently distrust or silently promote it.
rules.evidence: create_or_resolve_user_submitted_entity() always enqueues a review item by design

rules.statement: Free-text fields (activity/job/project/research/award titles) are never entity-resolution targets, no matter how proper-noun-like the text looks.
rules.evidence: canonical_field_policies.policy='free_text_remains' is an explicit prior product decision

rules.statement: A joint/co-organizer credit is not evidence that one organization owns or operates the other. Model as a peer relationship (partner_of candidate), never operated_by, never a merge.
rules.evidence: multiple live 'in partnership with' opportunities.organization strings naming two independent orgs

rules.statement: Wikipedia and Wikidata are never a value source for any fact, including identity -- discovery-index only.
rules.evidence: lib/acquisition/source-authority.ts EXCLUDED_DOMAINS already excludes both explicitly

rules.statement: A same-tier disagreement between two acceptable sources resolves to a recorded conflict, never a silently-picked winner -- for identity/relationship evidence exactly as for facts.
rules.evidence: precedence.ts's decideWrite() already returns 'conflict' rather than choosing a winner

rules.statement: A named school/faculty with its own admissions process and brand earns its own canonical entity related to its parent university; a narrower center/initiative defaults to no row until it recurs; a specific named program is a different entity_type (program/competition), never an alias of its provider.
rules.evidence: the live University of Pennsylvania / Wharton six-way organizer-string granularity cluster in opportunities.organization
